title: Recover without duplicating the request
when: A message is undelivered, parked or collapsed into an earlier message
need: Inspect message/attempt state and the earlier message when collapsed. No steering seat means parked for a successor. A turn ending sends no Fleet message. Cancellation and acknowledgement are separate explicit operations. Stale running recipients without an idle route use stopped-session resume automatically; inspect the original receipt and wake attempts before retrying. Steering reports automatically flag unresolved pending/injected receipts on ended sessions without remaining routes, using message visibility and confirmed item scope. Read and handle or re-address the work, then sender actor or target-project admin may cancel obsolete mail; report reads never settle receipts or replay QA. A parked, ended-seat or released-seat steering message handed to a new seat injects into it like a live send; acquire lists each ack command. Cancelled or expired steering mail settles: it leaves unacknowledged lists and handoffs, and the report names each open awaiting-seat message with its item and covering seat, giving the acquire command only for a seat the reader does not hold.
surface: Message receipt/output -> get; Items and Sessions recovery examples.
review: Candidate source tests prove every declared surface delivers at its hook, intentional operator waits remain uncharged, relay wakes that expire unreported refund their charge so explicit wakes retry until a bounded relay_lease_expired escalation, exhausted native routes notify the covering steering seat, and verified containment releases matching pending holds. Candidate recovery preserves process start-time evidence, supersedes old holds after a later delivered wake, and dates Fleet silence observations. Live release proof remains pending. Ended-session report composition is covered by disposable fixture regressions; deployed candidate proof remains pending. Narrow recipient reads exclude unrelated session history; duplicate failure notices check their durable identity before resolving recipients. Survey recovery retains the accepted write and rechecks live conflicts over eligible items.
